name: Shiva Consciousness (modulated 40 Hz 'binding factor')
origin: Pattern credited by the vendor to Dr. M.A. Persinger; Shiva software by Todd Murphy
summary: Murphy's simple Shiva 'Consciousness' session: a modulated 40 Hz signal stepped counter-clockwise around the head, in the vendor's words 'at almost the same frequency the binding factor sweeps through the brain'. Murphy writes that reports emphasise bliss and joy; testimonials on the vendor's site mention colours seeming brighter the next day and dream effects. All reported effects are testimonials.
notes: The vendor describes 'moving the signals from one pair to the next at almost the same frequency the binding factor sweeps through the brain' (m_40hz.htm) and calls the signal 'a phase-modulated 40Hz signal' (sacredneurology.com 2013). No modulation values and no step table are published. The page says the session was 'validated with empirical laboratory results obtained at the L.U. Neurosciences lab' but names no paper, and no paper read for this family tests a modulated 40 Hz signal on the ring. This file plays a 40 Hz sine, phase-modulated at 0.5 Hz with a depth of 3 rad, at 1-ms points; rate and depth are this project's values. Each coil is held 23 or 27 ms in turn, 200 ms per round: this has no source and is this project's inference from the vendor's sentence. Coils sit on the vendor's Shiva ring (Fp1, FT7, TP7, O1, O2, TP8, FT8, Fp2) and fire one at a time, counter-clockwise seen from above. Shiva has a coil pair at each position; one coil keeps the timing and covers about half the arc. The vendor's only number is for the Shakti version of this signal: 'The correct calibration will be 10mG for either channel, when measured from one coil' (obe45_consent.htm, 'Modulated 40 Hz Signal'), 1 uT read at the coil, sensor distance not stated. This program's setting is the peak field 20 mm in front of each coil. At 1 uT that is about 56 uT at the coil face, so the default can be up to 56 times above the vendor's calibration. Lower the intensity to approach it. All reported effects are testimonials. Independent sham-controlled tests of God-Helmet-type fields found no field effect (Granqvist 2005, double-blind; Gendle & McGrath 2012, where the experimenter knew the condition). Begin with the shorter version: stop after phase 1 for 20 min; phase 2 completes 30 min. Not for people with epilepsy; stop if distressed.
setting: Dark, quiet room, eyes closed, relaxed without meditating or falling asleep. Murphy suggests the 60-min version in sensory deprivation (darkness and silence) for effects during the session.
schedule: At most once a week, never on consecutive days; up to 6 sessions, then a 21-day break. 60-min sessions weekly or every two weeks at most.
